sources.entry: DNS Easy Switcher - Menu bar tool for switching DNS providers or custom resolvers. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/glinford/dns-easy-switcher) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: A macOS menu bar app for quickly switching between DNS providers (or custom DNS resolvers).
summary.what_it_does: DNS Easy Switcher is a menu bar utility for macOS that changes the system DNS server with a click. It includes presets for Cloudflare (1.1.1.1), Quad9 (9.9.9.9), AdGuard DNS (94.140.14.14), and GetFlix DNS with a list of locations. It can disable DNS overrides so DHCP-provided DNS is used, and lets you add and manage your own custom servers. It also includes a DNS speed test to find the fastest provider and a option to flush the DNS cache. The README says it supports IPv4 and IPv6, persists settings between launches, and states that it collects no data.
use_cases: switch DNS servers from the macOS menu bar
change to Cloudflare, Quad9, or AdGuard DNS
use a custom DNS resolver on a Mac
find the fastest DNS provider by speed test
how_to_run: Manual: download the latest release from the Releases page, mount the DMG, and drag the app to Applications
Build from source: git clone the repository, open the project in Xcode 15 or later, build and run
notable: Touch ID authentication for DNS changes
Built-in DNS speed test to pick the fastest provider
GetFlix DNS preset with a list of locations
Native macOS menu bar integration with settings persisted locally
caveats: Requires macOS 14.0 (Sonoma) or later; the tested configuration listed is only Sonoma 14.5
Administrator privileges are needed each time DNS settings are switched; Touch ID is only available on Touch ID-enabled Macs
Distributed outside the Mac App Store, so macOS shows a security warning on first launch and system extensions must be allowed
